config.title: Signal Camp — bundled construction
config.titleZh: 信标营地 · 整包建设

signal.windowReason: The transport boat leaves after turn 2. An early signal evacuates 6 people; later, the local boat can take only 2.
signal.windowReasonZh: 接驳船在第2回合结束后离开。及时发信号可接走6人；晚了只能由本地小船接走2人。

survey.windowReason: The tide covers two shallow crossings after turn 2. An early survey maps 3 routes; a later survey can map only 1.
survey.windowReasonZh: 第2回合结束后，涨潮淹没两条浅滩。及时勘测可标记3条路线；晚了只能标记1条。

goals.name: Evacuate the stranded group
goals.description: Evacuate all 6 people and leave at least 1 marked route for the next crew.
goals.descriptionZh: 接走全部6人，并为后续队伍留下至少1条已标记路线。

goals.name: Open routes for the next crew
goals.description: Mark all 3 routes and evacuate at least 2 people with the local boat.
goals.descriptionZh: 标记全部3条路线，同时至少用本地小船接走2人。

assumptions: All legal action sequences run to the same fixed horizon; no task completion ends the session early.
People and routes are separate outcomes, not supplies or a weighted score.
Equivalent current states are merged; witnesses remain complete legal histories.
This deterministic search proves reachable outcomes, not player comprehension or enjoyment.

checks.name: Original baseline retained
checks.description: Baseline configuration bytes and both executed baseline traces match the record made before writing the revised configuration.
checks.descriptionZh: 原版配置字节和两条实际轨迹，均与写入改版配置前保存的记录一致。

checks.name: Only construction availability changes
checks.description: Initial supplies, income, horizon, all prices, mission windows/outcomes and goal requirements are identical. Only construction availability differs.
checks.descriptionZh: 初始补给、逐回合到账、总时段、所有价格、任务窗口与结果、目标门槛均相同，只改变整包/分步建设开放方式。

checks.name: Same income at every matching turn
checks.description: All three completed witness routes receive [0,1,2,3,4,5,6] cumulative supplies, spend 8 and finish with 1. Initial supplies are 3; total available is 9.
checks.descriptionZh: 三条完整对照路线逐时段累计到账均为[0,1,2,3,4,5,6]，花费8、余额1。初始3，含初始总可用9。

checks.name: Three forced waits become a turn-one fork
checks.nameZh: 前三回合被动等待变为首回合分支
checks.description: Baseline turns 1–3 allow only waiting; construction first opens at turn 4. Revision turn 1 exposes two distinct module routes plus voluntary waiting.
checks.descriptionZh: 原版第1–3回合只能等待，第4回合首次可建设；改版第1回合开放两条结果不同的模块路线，并保留主动等待。

checks.name: Turn two counts; turn three is late
checks.nameZh: 第2回合有效，第3回合已迟
checks.description: Mission effects use the action being executed (turn + 1). Both early windows include turn 2; turn 3 pays the unchanged late outcome.
checks.descriptionZh: 任务按即将执行的回合turn+1结算；第2回合仍命中早期窗口，第3回合只能获得原有的晚期结果。

checks.name: The preferred module reverses with the goal
checks.nameZh: 目标变化，优先模块反转
checks.description: Beacon first satisfies 6 people + 1 route; survey kit first satisfies 2 people + 3 routes. The other ordering fails that same hard goal.
checks.descriptionZh: 信标先行达到6人+1路线；勘测先行达到2人+3路线。目标互换后，同一路线不再达标。

checks.name: Search every legal future
checks.description: The reachable frontier is (6 people,1 route) or (2 people,3 routes). No legal sequence attains both high outcomes; only its matching first module can attain each hard goal.
checks.descriptionZh: 可达前沿只有(6人,1路线)和(2人,3路线)；没有合法序列同时拿到两种高结果。每个硬目标只能从对应的首回合模块达到。

checks.name: Waiting remains and construction takes another action
checks.nameZh: 等待仍在，建设多占一次行动
checks.description: The modular witnesses still wait on turns 3 and 4 and spend two construction actions instead of one. They move a consequential choice earlier; they do not remove all waiting.
checks.descriptionZh: 改版对照路线第3、4回合仍等待，建设从一次变为两次。它把有后果的选择前移，并没有消除所有等待。

checks.name: The retained bundle misses both early goals
checks.nameZh: 保留整包无法赶上两个早期目标
checks.description: The retained bundle and a turn-one wait cannot reach either stated goal. They are convenience/comparison options, not a claimed third competitive strategy.
checks.descriptionZh: 保留整包或首回合先等待，都无法达到任一既定目标。它们是对照/便捷选项，不能称为第三条同样有效的策略。

checks.name: Conservation and previews hold in every reachable state
checks.nameZh: 所有可达状态收支与预览一致
checks.description: Every reachable state balances initial + gross income − spending. Every legal action matches its preview, and all rejected actions preserve state and receive no delivery.
checks.descriptionZh: 所有可达状态都满足初始+毛收入−支出=余额。每个合法动作与预览一致；拒绝动作不改变状态，也不额外到账。

checks.name: The horizon is fixed even after task completion
checks.nameZh: 任务完成后仍保持固定时长
checks.description: A labeled high-starting-supply boundary fixture completes tasks at turn 3 but continues to turn 6. Final-turn mission effects and delivery resolve before closure; no seventh action runs.
checks.descriptionZh: 标注的高初始补给边界测试在第3回合完成任务仍继续到第6回合。最后一回合先结算任务和到账再关闭，不允许第7次行动。

checks.name: No duplicate purchases or repeat rewards
checks.nameZh: 不能重复建设或刷任务结果
checks.description: A labeled high-supply boundary fixture cannot buy the same module, rebuy the whole bundle after a partial build, or repeat a completed mission.
checks.descriptionZh: 标注的高补给边界测试不能重买已有模块、部分建设后再买整包，或重复执行已完成任务。

limitations: The baseline is an original deliberately constrained comparison, not a measured defect in a released commercial game.
People and route coverage are outcomes, not the supply resource. Only supply production is held constant.
The original brief requests both versions; no later user feedback or human playtest is invented.
All paths receive the same per-turn supplies; different uncompleted paths may spend different amounts or keep different balances.
The modular witnesses still wait twice and require an extra construction action. Choosing the wrong first module permanently misses the selected goal.
The retained bundle is dominated for these two goals. No claim is made that every available button is strategically competitive.
Automated search and tests establish this model, not comprehension, fun, retention or general superiority.
